INSERT INTO wa_group_participant ( group_id, pn_jid, phone, presence_status, presence_source, presence_observed_at, presence_event_id, role, role_source, role_observed_at, role_event_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES
( #{row.groupId}, #{row.pnJid}, #{row.phone}, 1, 'GROUP_SNAPSHOT', #{row.syncAt}, #{row.eventId}, #{row.role}, CASE WHEN #{row.role} = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 'GROUP_SNAPSHOT' END, CASE WHEN #{row.role} = 0 THEN NULL ELSE #{row.syncAt} END, CASE WHEN #{row.role} = 0 THEN NULL ELSE #{row.eventId} END, #{row.now}, #{row.now} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE phone = COALESCE(VALUES(phone), phone), presence_status = CASE WHEN THEN VALUES(presence_status) ELSE presence_status END, presence_source = CASE WHEN THEN VALUES(presence_source) ELSE presence_source END, presence_event_id = CASE WHEN THEN VALUES(presence_event_id) ELSE presence_event_id END, presence_observed_at = GREATEST( COALESCE(presence_observed_at, VALUES(presence_observed_at)), VALUES(presence_observed_at) ), role = CASE WHEN VALUES(role) <> 0 AND THEN VALUES(role) ELSE role END, role_source = CASE WHEN VALUES(role) <> 0 AND THEN VALUES(role_source) ELSE role_source END, role_event_id = CASE WHEN VALUES(role) <> 0 AND THEN VALUES(role_event_id) ELSE role_event_id END, role_observed_at = CASE WHEN VALUES(role) <> 0 AND THEN VALUES(role_observed_at) ELSE role_observed_at END, updated_at = GREATEST(updated_at, VALUES(updated_at))

INSERT INTO account_group_sync_state ( account_id, baseline_state, baseline_completeness, baseline_captured_at, baseline_group_count, last_sync_requested_at, last_reported_at, last_snapshot_complete, last_complete_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{row.accountId}, #{row.baselineState}, #{row.baselineCompleteness}, #{row.baselineCapturedAt}, #{row.baselineGroupCount}, #{row.lastSyncRequestedAt}, #{row.lastReportedAt}, CASE WHEN #{row.snapshotComplete} = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, #{row.lastCompleteAt}, #{row.now}, #{row.now} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE baseline_state = VALUES(baseline_state), baseline_completeness = CASE WHEN account_group_sync_state.baseline_completeness = 1 THEN 1 ELSE VALUES(baseline_completeness) END, baseline_captured_at = VALUES(baseline_captured_at), baseline_group_count = VALUES(baseline_group_count), last_sync_requested_at = CASE WHEN VALUES(last_sync_requested_at) IS NULL THEN last_sync_requested_at WHEN last_sync_requested_at IS NULL THEN VALUES(last_sync_requested_at) ELSE GREATEST(last_sync_requested_at, VALUES(last_sync_requested_at)) END, last_snapshot_complete = CASE WHEN account_group_sync_state.last_reported_at IS NULL OR VALUES(last_reported_at) >= account_group_sync_state.last_reported_at THEN VALUES(last_snapshot_complete) ELSE account_group_sync_state.last_snapshot_complete END, last_complete_at = CASE WHEN VALUES(last_complete_at) IS NULL THEN account_group_sync_state.last_complete_at WHEN account_group_sync_state.last_complete_at IS NULL THEN VALUES(last_complete_at) ELSE GREATEST(account_group_sync_state.last_complete_at, VALUES(last_complete_at)) END, last_reported_at = GREATEST( COALESCE(account_group_sync_state.last_reported_at, VALUES(last_reported_at)), VALUES(last_reported_at) ), updated_at = GREATEST(account_group_sync_state.updated_at, VALUES(updated_at))
